[b]Badges[/b] are craftable items that Survivors can equip to become stronger. [b]Badge Effects[/b] can increase your Damage, Health, Critical Hit chance, and more!
Badges can be crafted using [b]Badge Fragments[/b] and [b]Components[/b], which you can get from Missions and the Shop.
Start crafting Badges in your Camp's [b]Craftsman[/b] building, or by tapping the Craftsman button in the Survivor’s Badges tab.
Each [b]Badge Slot[/b] can only hold Badges that are the same shape. A Survivor can equip up to 3 Badges with the same Effect type.
[b]Badge’s Set[/b] is indicated by the uniquely shaped ring around the Effect icon. If a Survivor has 4 or more Badges from the same Badge Set equipped, those badges get a 20% Effect Boost!

Badges can have a [b]Secondary Condition[/b] - if fulfilled, an additional bonus is given to the Badge’s Effect. In the small Badge Indicator, equipped Badges are white and Badges with an fulfilled Secondary Condition are shown in green.
To craft a badge, simply use one Badge Fragment and four Components. The rarer the crafting materials, the more likely you are to get a stronger [b]Badge Effect[/b]!
Match a [b]Recipe’s[/b] set of Components to get an increased chance of crafting a Badge with the Effect you want. Using higher rarity Components improves the Recipe’s effectiveness.

Badge Slot and Set are completely random.
Happy crafting!
Got the perfect Badge but with a sub-optimal Set? You can reroll each of the following Attributes separately: Slot, Set and Bonus.
Start rerolling by tapping a Badge in your Inventory or by pressing the "Details" button right after crafting. Then select which Attribute you want to reroll.
Rerolling requires [b]Reroll Tokens[/b] that can be acquired from various game-modes, events and the Shop. Each time a Badge's Attribute is rerolled, it requires more Tokens to reroll again.
Each Badge slot can only hold Badges that are the same shape. A Survivor can use up to three Badges with the same icon. The Survivor will gain the effect described by the large value.

If the Survivor meets the listed condition, such as having a certain Hero in the user’s mission team, the effect of the badge is increased. In the small Badge indicator, equipped Badges are white, and Badges whose conditions are met are shown in green.
A Badge’s set is indicated by the gear-shaped ring around the effect icon. If a Survivor has 4 or more Badges from the same set equipped, those badges get a 20% effect boost!

Subscription: Negan’s Deal
The "Negan's Deal" subscription service is available exclusively for mobile purchases on iOS and Android. 
If you are a Steam / Epic / Bluestacks platform user, please subscribe via mobile. 
After subscribing, the features will automatically synchronize across all platforms. 
We apologize for the inconvenience here.

Pricing and Duration：
The subscription is available in two cycles:
· 7 days: $0.99
· 30 days: $1.99

Benefits：
Subscribing to "Negan's Deal" offers the following perks during the subscription period:
1. Battle Rewind: Undo one move per battle. This function can be used once per battle (not available in Guild Wars).
2. Healing Privilege: Characters no longer need healing time after being injured.
3. Extra Last Stand Attempts: Get two extra free attempts in each "Last Stand" event.

Auto Renewal (iOS):
Due to App Store restrictions, all subscriptions through the App Store are automatically renewed via your iTunes account. Please note the following:
· The subscription will automatically renew within 24 hours before the end of the current period.
· To avoid auto-renewal, you must manually disable it in your iTunes/Apple ID settings at least 24 hours before the subscription period ends.
· If auto-renewal is not canceled in time, the subscription will automatically continue.

Auto Renewal (Google):
The Google Play subscription feature is an auto-renewing subscription, with payments processed and confirmed by Google Play. Please note the following:
· Subscription auto-renewal charges are processed within 24 hours before the end of each subscription period and confirmed by Google Play.
· To cancel the auto-renewal, you must manually disable it in your Play Store account settings at least 24 hours before the subscription period ends.
· If auto-renewal is not disabled in time, the subscription will automatically renew for the next period.

How to Cancel (iOS):
To cancel your subscription on iOS:
1. Open Settings on your device.
2. Select iTunes Store & App Store.
3. Tap your Apple ID and choose View Apple ID.
4. Navigate to Account Settings > Subscriptions > Manage.
5. Select The Walking Dead: No Man's Land subscription and cancel it.

How to Cancel (Google)
If you wish to cancel your subscription, follow these steps:
1. Open the Play Store on your Android device.
2. Navigate to Account Settings and select Subscriptions.
3. Tap Manage and choose the subscription for "The Walking Dead: No Man's Land".
4. Follow the prompts to complete the cancellation process.
By managing your subscription settings proactively, you can avoid unwanted renewals. Let us know if you need further assistance.

Brace yourselves, the Winter is coming! Earn Winter Tokens by playing various missions throughout the game. As you collect tokens, you will unlock a range of rewards, including the new weapon AirDrill and new tokens—EX Token & MT Token!

Here comes the Support Talent Tree System — a whole new way to power up your Supports and unlock their full potential!

Each Support now has their own set of Talent Trees. By investing in materials, you can activate different nodes within these trees to gain extra benefits.
There are two types of nodes:
Attribute Nodes: Provide permanent stat boosts once unlocked — no need to equip anything!

Talent Nodes: Unlock unique Supporter Talents. Once equipped in the Talent interface, these will grant special bonuses to any Survivor using that Support.

You’ll also find a new Talent Adjustment feature in the Support interface, allowing you to equip and manage the Talents you’ve unlocked.
Get ready to explore new build possibilities and make your favorite Supports stronger than ever! Enjoy!

Introducing the Survival Manual!

Dive into the ultimate storybook of your favorite heroes from the show! Collect character pictures, read their stories, and fill up your Survival Manual as you play.

For fans, this is the most meaningful way to progress. All 51 heroes are grouped into 9 story collections based on their seasons and plot arcs. Each collection features high-quality scene stills, letting you revisit iconic moments while playing.

Completing collections also grants powerful stat bonuses to help you tackle harder missions and earn better rewards.

The Survival Manual is a permanent system, with rotating limited-time Story Collection Events to keep things fresh.

Access it once your Council reaches Level 16: Camp → Survivors → Survival Manual.

Start collecting, relive the stories, and power up your heroes today!

Hello Survivors,
We’re excited to introduce a brand-new feature to the game: the Spin Wheel System - Jade Reckoning, offering a layered reward experience with increasing value as you progress.
 
How It Works
The system consists of two stages:
 
Stage 1: Main Wheel
The Main Wheel contains a wide pool of rewards, primarily focused on upgrading resources to support your progression.
Each spin grants you one of the available rewards.
Once all rewards on the Main Wheel have been obtained, you will unlock access to the next stage.

Stage 2: Jackpot
After clearing the Main Wheel, you will enter the Jackpot Wheel.
This wheel features high-value rewards, including:
· Exclusive Equipment
· Blueprints
· Avatars & Frames

We hope you enjoy this new feature and the rewards it brings. As always, thank you for your continued support!
Good luck, and spin wisely!

Survivors,

We are aware that multiple issues and bugs have recently occurred in Guild War, and that some of these problems have negatively affected the gameplay experience. We sincerely apologize to all players impacted by these issues. As a token of appreciation for your patience and support during this period, we will also prepare a free compensation package for all players containing all rewards currently available in the Guild War Shop.

At the moment, the team is urgently investigating and working on fixes, while also preparing an optimization update package focused on resolving the blue dot issue.

As the current Guild War season is still ongoing, we want to minimize the impact on existing battles as much as possible. Therefore, we plan to deploy the update during the week of the 18th, with the official phased testing beginning in the new Guild War cycle starting on May 25th.

We would also like to be transparent with everyone in advance:

Because these fixes will be introduced gradually through phased testing, a small number of players may experience instability or encounter new unexpected issues during the testing period. We completely understand that this may be frustrating, and we sincerely appreciate your patience and understanding.

If you encounter any related issues during the test, we kindly ask that you contact the project team and provide any relevant information, screenshots, or reproduction steps whenever possible. These reports are extremely valuable in helping us reproduce issues, identify root causes more accurately, and improve the reliability of the final fix.

For players who actively assist us by providing useful reports and investigation details, we will also prepare meaningful thank-you rewards as a token of our appreciation.

We understand that fixing issues is not simply about releasing a patch — it is about continuously listening to player feedback and working together toward lasting improvements.

Thank you again for your continued support, patience, and understanding as we work to improve the overall experience.

— The Team

Survivors, thank you for your patience.
After receiving a large number of bug reports from the community (far more than expected), we are now fully focused on fixing all known issues. Our team has been continuously working on emergency fixes, including over the weekend.
We would like to share the latest update and testing plan:
Starting from next week’s Guild War, we will gradually begin a full-server testing and live repair phase.
During this period, frequent hotfix updates may occur, and we will do our best to minimize the impact while ensuring overall stability.
We fully understand that this process may cause inconvenience and disruption, but it also reflects our determination and prioritization to fully resolve these issues as quickly and thoroughly as possible.
We also encourage all players to continue participating in Guild War as normal, and to actively report any issues encountered during gameplay.
To help us identify and resolve problems more efficiently, we kindly ask players to include the following information when submitting bug reports:
  1. Time when the bug occurred 
  2. Detailed context (stage number, equipment, squad members, and any actions before/after the issue) 
  3. If the issue involves being kicked from the game, please specify the type: 
   · Disconnect and reconnect 
   · Game crash with auto-reconnect 
   · Game crash requiring manual restart 
   · Crash triggered by a specific button 
   · Crash occurring during a specific hero action 
  4. If possible, please provide video or screen recording 
 
This information is extremely important for reproducing issues and accurately identifying root causes.
As a thank you, players who provide valid bug reports will receive Gold Radio ×3.
For players who actively assist us in identifying and resolving issues over time, we will also provide an additional Gold Radio ×10 as a token of our sincere appreciation.
Finally, the phased testing plan scheduled for May 25th will proceed as originally planned.
Thank you again for your continued patience, feedback, and support. We are doing everything we can to restore a more stable gameplay experience as soon as possible.

— The Team

We have made the following adjustments to the new equipment Negan's Death Deceiver:
Trait Adjustment
Previously, the immunity effect would end early after any action taken by the wielder.
This has now been adjusted so that only movement will end the immunity effect early.
In addition, we have clarified in the equipment description that this effect can only activate once per battle.
Updated Effect
Upon receiving lethal damage, the wielder is not killed. Instead, they become immune to all sources of damage until the next Survivor's turn and immediately recover 50% of their Max HP. Any movement taken by the wielder ends the damage immunity early.
 (This effect only triggers when not in an Injured/Struggling State and can only activate once per battle.)
Thank you for your continued feedback and support. We will continue monitoring equipment performance and overall combat experience.
— The Team

Survivors,
We'd like to take this opportunity to share an update to how we communicate game changes.
To help everyone stay informed about changes to the game more clearly and promptly, any future adjustments that may affect gameplay or combat performance will be explained through official announcements.
Our goal is to make every update as transparent as possible. Whether it's new content, balance adjustments, or bug fixes, we will do our best to communicate them with you as early as possible.
We believe that timely communication helps everyone better understand each update and enjoy the game with greater confidence.
Thank you for your continued feedback and support. We will keep improving the way we communicate and work together with the community to create an even better gameplay experience.
— The Team
